messages:
Marta - Procurement: Heads up 14B04C4 QuotaFlex renewal landed. Two structures: seat+pool vs pure usage. Need quick risk/cost read. PDF on Drive: https://drive.google.com/qf-proposal. @Sanjay @Alex @Ting Li

Sanjay (ML Eng): Can you paste the quote snippets here? quick numbers are easiest.

Marta - Procurement: Paste: 
```
Seat+Pool:
  8 seats @ $900/mo = $7,200/mo
  Included: 400M embeddings/mo pooled
  Overage: $0.000011/embed
  Support: Standard
Pure Usage:
  $0.000019/embed
  Tier: >1B/quarter -> 12% discount
  NET30, 12mo term
```

Alex (Finance): Quick calc: current run ~100M/mo -> 1.2B/yr. Pure usage w/o discount = $22,800/yr. Seats = $86,400/yr. Usage clearly cheaper today. But seats give predictability and may include nicer SLAs. Need invoice cadence and sample invoice for peak month.

Ting Li (Platform): Engineering asks: are included units pooled org-wide? How do they meter embeddings (per call, per vector dimension, or by token)? Also: latency SLA on embedding endpoint?

Sanjay (ML Eng): We should request a hybrid: smaller reserved pool + usage overlay. If they allow 400M pooled, maybe reduce to 150M + lower overage.

QuotaFlex Rep: Hi all 44B We can do hybrid: 4 seats + 150M included + overlay @ $0.000012/embed. Or pure usage with a 12mo commit -> 15% off list. Included units are org-pooled. Metering is per-embedding call; vector dimensionality does not change count but affects compute pricing internally. SLA add-on available. Can provide sample invoice and peak-month billing example.

Marta - Procurement: Good. Please send revised quote and sample invoice + explicit meter definition and overage calc language. Also confirm data residency (we need us-west) and termination/export terms.

QuotaFlex Rep: Will send revised quote + sample invoice by EOD. Data residency: us-west OK. Termination: 60-day wind-down, data export included.

Alex (Finance): Also ask for an annual price cap clause (max X% increase) and credits for downtime > SLA. Need to model committed spend vs variable.

Sanjay (ML Eng): Request p50/p95/p99 latency for embedding endpoint at our expected QPS and at peak 2x traffic. Our p95 target is <50ms for 96-dim vectors.

Ting Li (Platform): Confirm support for cross-project pooling and per-team reporting in invoice (line items).

Marta - Procurement: @Procurement-Bot open PR when quote arrives and add approvers: Alex, Legal, Security.

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #478: "QuotaFlex - renewal review". Approvers requested: Alex (Finance), Legal, Security. Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/478

Marta - Procurement: Thanks team. Once revised docs are here well triage quickly. :thumbsup:
